rationales: This is the unit of velocity, not acceleration.
This is also the unit of velocity, not acceleration.
Acceleration has SI unit m·s⁻².
This is not the SI unit of acceleration.
Torque is the turning effect of a force, not the rate of change of momentum.
By Newton’s second law, force is the rate of change of momentum.
Work is energy transferred by a force through a displacement.
Distance is a measure of length, not a rate of change of momentum.
N·m is the unit of torque or work.
N·s⁻¹ is not the unit of momentum.
kg·m·s⁻² is the unit of force.
Momentum has SI unit kg·m·s⁻¹.
One liter is equal to 1000 cm³.
100 cm³ is 0.1 liter.
10 cm³ is 0.01 liter.
1 cm³ is 0.001 liter.
The sum of position vectors is not the second condition of equilibrium.
ΣF = 0 is the first condition of equilibrium.
ΣP = 0 is not the mathematical form of the second condition.
The second condition of equilibrium is that the net torque is zero.
Power is work done per unit time, W/t.
W/t² is not the formula for power.
W²/t is not the formula for power.
W²/t² is not the formula for power.
Work is maximum when force and displacement are in the same direction, at 0°.
At 60°, only half the force contributes along the displacement.
At 90°, the force does no work along the displacement.
At 180°, work is negative and has its minimum value.
At the highest position, the body is in unstable equilibrium.
At the lowest position, the body is in stable equilibrium.
In neutral equilibrium, displacement does not change the center of gravity’s height.
Being situated at the bottom is associated with stable equilibrium, not neutral equilibrium.
Oil acts as a lubricant and reduces friction between metal plates.
Water is not the usual lubricant for reducing friction between metal plates.
Fine marble powder generally increases friction rather than lowering it.
Air is not the material typically used to lubricate metal plates.
Circular motion describes motion along a circular path, not specifically motion about an axis.
Motion of a body about an axis is called rotatory motion.
Vibratory motion is repeated to-and-fro motion.
Random motion has no fixed path or direction.
0.1 mm is larger than the usual least count of a school screw gauge.
A typical school screw gauge has a least count of 0.01 mm.
1 mm is too large to be the usual screw-gauge least count.
0.001 mm is smaller than the usual school screw-gauge least count.
0°F is below water’s freezing point.
Water freezes at 32°F under standard atmospheric pressure.
−273 K is not a valid temperature on the Kelvin scale.
0 K is absolute zero, not water’s freezing point.
10⁴ N·m⁻² is not equal to one pascal.
One pascal is equal to one newton per square metre.
10² N·m⁻² is not equal to one pascal.
10³ N·m⁻² is not equal to one pascal.
Chemical energy is stored in chemical bonds.
Potential energy is due to position or configuration.
Nuclear energy is stored in atomic nuclei.
Energy due to motion is kinetic energy.
Coal does not store nuclear energy.
Heat energy is released when coal burns, but its stored energy is chemical.
Coal stores energy in its chemical bonds.
Kinetic energy is energy of motion, not stored in coal.
